arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ كَلَّفْتَنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا أَنْتَ أَمْلَكُ بِهِ مِنِّي،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka kallafatanī min nafsī mā anta amliku bihī minnī
english_text: O God, Thou hast charged me concerning myself with that which belongs more to Thee than to me.

arabic_text: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيَّ أَغْلَبُ مِنْ قُدْرَتِي، فَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّي، وَخُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ رِضَاهَا مِنْ نَفْسِي فِي عَافِيَة.
transliteration: wa qudratuka ʿalayhi wa ʿalayya aghlabu min qudrati fa'ātini min nafsi mā yurḍīka 'annī wakhudh li nafsika ridhaha min nafsi fi 'afiya
english_text: Thy power over it and over me is greater than my power, so give me in myself what will make Thee pleased with me and take for Thyself Thy good pleasure in my self's well-being!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَاقَةَ لِي بِالجَهْدِ ، وَلاَ صَبْرَ لِي عَلَى البَلاَءِ، وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْفَقْرِ، فَلاَ تَحْظُرْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي، وَلاَ تَكِلْنِيْ إلَى خَلْقِكَ بَلْ تَفَرَّدْ بِحَاجَتِي، وَتَولَّ كِفَايَتِي،
transliteration: allāhumma lā ṭāqata lī bil-jahdi, wa lā ṣabr lī ʿalal-balāʾi wala quwwata liya 'ala al-faqr, fa la tahzur 'alayya rizqi wala takilni ila khalkika bal tafarrad bihajati, wa tawallā kifāyati
english_text: O God, I have no endurance for effort, no patience in affliction, no strength to bear poverty. So forbid me not my provision and entrust me not to Thy creatures, but take care of my need alone and Thyself attend to sufficing me!

arabic_text: وَانْظُرْ إلَيَّ وَانْظُرْ لِي فِي جَمِيْعِ اُمُورِي، فَإنَّكَ إنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إلَى نَفْسِي عَجَزْتُ عَنْهَا، وَلَمْ اُقِمْ مَا فِيهِ مَصْلَحَتُهَا،
transliteration: wa anẓur ilayya wa anẓur li fi jamii'i umoori fa'innaka in wakaltani ila nafsi 'ajaztu 'anha wa lam uqim ma feehi maslahatuhā
english_text: Look upon me and look after me in all my affairs, for if Thou entrustest me to myself, I will be incapable before myself and fail to undertake that in which my best interest lies.

arabic_text: وَإنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إلَى خَلْقِكَ تَجَهَّمُونِي، وَإنْ أَلْجَأتَنِيْ إلَى قَرَابَتِي حَرَمُونِي،
transliteration: wa-in wakaltanī ilá khalqika tajahhamūnī wa in aljaitani ila qarabati haramooni
english_text: If Thou entrustest me to Thy creatures, they will frown upon me, and if Thou makest me resort to my kinsfolk, they will refuse to give to me;

arabic_text: وَإنْ أَعْطَوْا أَعْطَوْا قَلِيْلاً نَكِداً، وَمَنُّوا عَلَيَّ طَوِيلاً وَذَمُّوا كَثِيراً.
transliteration: wa in aʿṭaw aʿṭaw qalīlan nakidān wa mannū ʿalayya ṭawīlān wa ḏammū kathīran
english_text: if they give, they will give little and in bad temper, making me feel long obliged and blaming me much.

arabic_text: فَبِفَضْلِكَ أللَّهُمَّ فَأَغْنِنِي، وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ فَانْعَشنِي، وَبِسَعَتِكَ فَابْسُطْ يَدِي، وَبِمَا عِنْدَكَ فَاكْفِنِي.
transliteration: fabi-faḍlika allāhumma fa-agh-ninī, wa-bi-ʿaẓamatika fa-unʿash-nī wa bis`atika fabṣuṭ yadī, wa bimā `indaka fākfinī
english_text: So through Thy bounty, O God, free me from need, through Thy mightiness, lift me up, through Thy boundless plenty, open my hand, and with that which is with Thee, suffice me!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَخَلِّصْنِي مِنَ الْحَسَدِ، وَاحْصُرْنِي عَن الذُّنُوبِ، وَوَرِّعْنِي عَنِ الْمَحَارِمِ، وَلا تُجَرِّئْنِي عَلَى الْمَعَاصِي، وَاجْعَلْ هَوايَ عِنْدَكَ، وَرِضَايَ فِيمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa khallissni minal hasadi, wa ahsurni an-thonoob wa warriʿnī ʿanil-maḥārimi, wa lā tujarriʾnī ʿalal-maʿāṣī wajʿal hawāya ʿindaka wa-riḍāya fīmā yaridu ʿalayya minka
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, rid me of envy, encircle me against sins, make me abstain from things unlawful, give me not the boldness of disobedient acts, assign me love for that which is with Thee and satisfaction with that which comes to me from Thee,

arabic_text: وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَفِيمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي، وَفِيمَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي كُلِّ حَالاَتِي مَحْفُوظَاً مَكْلُوءاً مَسْتُوراً مَمْنُوعاً مُعَاذاً مُجَاراً.
transliteration: wa bārik lī fīmā razaqtanī, wa fīmā khawwaltanī wa fīmā anʿamta bihī ʿalayya, wajʿalnī fī kulli ḥālatī maḥfūẓan maklūʾan mastūran mamnūʿan muʿāḏan mujāran
english_text: bless me in that which Thou providest me, that which Thou conferrest upon me, and that through which Thou favourest me, and make me in all my states safeguarded, watched, covered, defended, given refuge, and granted sanctuary!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاقْضِ عَنِّي كُلّ مَا أَلْزَمْتَنِيهِ وَفَرَضْتَهُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ فِي وَجْه مِنْ وُجُوهِ طَاعَتِكَ، أَوْ لِخَلْق مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَإنْ ضَعُفَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ بَدَنِي، وَوَهَنَتْ عَنْهُ قُـوَّتِي، وَلَمْ تَنَلْهُ مَقْدِرَتِي، وَلَمْ يَسَعْهُ مَالِي وَلاَ ذَاتُ يَدِي، ذَكَرْتُهُ أَوْ نَسِيتُهُ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī waqḍi ʿannī kulla mā alzamtanīhi wa faraḍtahu ʿalayya laka fī wajhi min wujūhi ṭ aw li-khalq min khalqika wa-in da'ufa 'an dhalika badani, wa-wahant 'anhu quwwati walamlan talhu maqdirati, walaml yasahhu malii wala dhatu yadi, dhakartuhu aw naseetuhu.
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and let me accomplish everything which Thou hast enjoined upon me or made obligatory for me toward Thee, in one of the ways of Thy obedience, or toward one of Thy creatures, though my body be too frail for that, my strength too feeble, my power not able to reach it, and my possessions and what my hand owns not encompass it, and whether I have remembered it or forgotten it.

arabic_text: هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِمَّا قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَأَغْفَلْتُهُ أَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِي،
transliteration: huwa ya rabbi mimma qad ahsaytahu ʿalayya wa aghfalthu anā min nafsi
english_text: It, my Lord, is among that which Thou hast counted against me while I have been heedless of it in myself.

arabic_text: فَأَدِّهِ عَنِّي مِنْ جَزِيْلِ عَطِيَّتِكَ وَكَثِيرِ مَا عِنْدَكَ، فَإنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَبْقَى عَلَيَّ شَيْ مِنْهُ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاصَّنِي بِهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي، أَوْ تُضَاعِفَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ يَا رَبِّ.
transliteration: fa'addihi 'anni min jazīli 'aṭiyyatika wa kathīri mā 'indaka fa'innaka wasi'un karimun hatta la yabqa 'alayya shay'un minhu turīdu an tuqāṣṣanī bihī min ḥasanātī aw tudhaa'ifa bihi min sayyi'ati yawmi alqaaka yaa rabbi
english_text: Let me perform it through Thy plentiful giving and the abundance which is with Thee - for Thou art Boundless, Generous - so that nothing of it may remain against me, lest Thou wouldst wish to settle accounts for it from my good deeds or to compound my evil deeds on the day I meet Thee, my Lord!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَارْزُقْنِي الرَّغْبَةَ فِي الْعَمَـلِ لَكَ لآخِـرَتِي، حَتَّى أَعْرِفَ صِدْقَ ذلِكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي، وَحَتَّى يَكُونَ الْغَالِبُ عَلَيَّ الزُّهْدُ فِي دُنْيَايَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-rzuqny al-raghbah fi al-ʿamal lika li-akhirati ḥattā ʾaʿrifa ṣidqa dhālika min qalbī wa hattā yakūna al-ghālibu ʿalayya al-zuhdu fī dunyāya
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide me with desire to serve Thee for the sake of my state in the hereafter, such that I know the truthfulness of that [desire] in my heart, be dominated by renunciation while in this world,

arabic_text: وَحَتَّى أَعْمَلَ الْحَسَنَاتِ شَوْقاً، وَآمَنَ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ فَرَقاً وَخَوْفاً،
transliteration: wa-ḥattá aʿmala al-ḥasanāti shawqan wa āmana mina as-sayyiāti faraqan wa khawfan
english_text: do good deeds with yearning, and remain secure from evil deeds in fright and fear!

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً أَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ، وَأَهْتَدِي بِهِ فِي الظُّلُماتِ، وَأَسْتَضِيءُ بِهِ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالشُّبُهَـاتِ .
transliteration: wahab li nuran amshi bihi fi al-nas, wa-ahtadi bihi fi al-thulumat wa-astadī'u bihī mina ash-shakki wa ash-shubuhāt.
english_text: And give me 'a light whereby I may walk among the people' (ref.6:122), be guided in the shadows, and seek illumination in doubt and uncertainty!

arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَارْزُقْنِي خَوْفَ غَمِّ الْوَعِيْـدِ، وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى أَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا أَدْعُوكَ لَهُ، وَكَأْبَةَ مَا أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنْهُ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi warzuqni khawfa ghammil-wa'eed wa-shawqa thawabi al-maw'udi hatta ajida ladhata ma ad'uuka lahu wa ka'batan ma astajiru bika minhu
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide me with fear of the threatened gloom and yearning for the promised reward, such that I may find the pleasure of that for which I supplicate Thee and the sorrow of that from which I seek sanctuary in Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ قَـدْ تَعْلَمُ مَا يُصْلِحُنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِـرَتِي، فَكُنْ بِحَوَائِجِيْ حَفِيّاً.
transliteration: allāhumma qad taʿlamu mā yuṣliḥunī min amri dunyāyā wa ākhiratī fakun bihawāʾijī ḥafiyyan
english_text: O God, Thou knowest what will set my affairs right in this world and the next, so be ever gracious toward my needs!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد وَارْزُقْنِي الْحَقَّ عِنْدَ تَقْصِيرِي فِي الشُّكْرِ لَكَ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فِي اليُسـرِ وَالْعُسْرِ وَالصِّحَّـةِ وَالسَّقَمِ حَتَّى أَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ نَفْسِي رَوْحَ الرِّضَا
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa arzuqni al-haqq'a 'inda taqṣeeri fi al-shukri laka bimā an'amta 'alayya fīl-yusr wal-'usr was-ṣiḥḥati was-saqam ḥattā ʾataʿarrafamin nafsī rūḥar-riḍā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household and provide me with what is Thy right when I fall short in thanking Thee for that through which Thou hast favoured me in ease and difficulty, health and sickness, such that I may come to know in myself repose in satisfaction

arabic_text: وَطُمَأنِينَةَ النَّفْسِ مِنِّي بِمَا يَجِبُ لَكَ فِيمَا يَحْدُثُ فِي حَالِ الْخَوْفِ وَالاَمْنِ، وَالرِّضَا وَالسُّخْطِ، وَالضَّرِّ وَالنَّفْعِ.
transliteration: wa ṭumāʾinnaẗ al-nafs minnī bimā yajibu laka fīmā yaḥduthu fī ḥāli al-khawfi wal-amni wal-riḍā wa-s-sukhṭi, wa-ḍ-ḍarri wa-n-naʿfi
english_text: and serenity of soul in that which Thou hast made incumbent upon me in whatever states may occur: fear and security, satisfaction and displeasure, loss and gain!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَارْزُقْنِي سَلاَمَةَ الصَّدْرِ مِنَ الْحَسَدِ حَتَّى لاَ أَحْسُدَ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ عَلَى شَيْء مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، وَحَتَّى لاَ أَرى نِعْمَـةً مِنْ نِعَمِـكَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa arzuqni salamata al-sadr min al-hasad ḥatta lā ʾaḥsuda ʾaḥadan min khalqika ʿalā shayʾin min faḍlika wa-ḥattā lā ʾarā niʿmatan min niʿamika ʿalā ʾaḥad min khalqika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide me with a breast safe from envy, such that I envy none of Thy creatures and in anything of Thy bounty and such that I see none of Thy favours toward any of Thy creatures

arabic_text: فِي دِيْن أَوْ دُنْيا، أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ تَقْوَى، أَوْ سَعَة أَوْ رَخاء، إلاّ رَجَوْتُ لِنَفْسِي أَفْضَلَ ذلِكَ، بِكَ وَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
transliteration: fī dīn aw dunyā, aw ʿāfiyah aw taqwá aw saʿah aw rakhaa', illa rajawtu linafsi afḍala dhālika bi-ka wa-min-ka wa-ḥdak, lā sharīka lak
english_text: in religion or this world, well-being or reverential fear, plenty or ease, without hoping for myself better than it through and from Thee alone, who hast no associate!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَارْزُقْنِي التَّحَفُّظَ مِن الْخَطَايَا، وَالاحْتِرَاسَ مِنَ الزَّلَلِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، فِي حَالِ الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-rzuqnī at-taḥaffuẓa min al-khaṭāyā wal-iḥtirās mina azzalal fī d-dunyā wal-ākhira fī ḥāli ar-riḍā wal-ghaḍabِ،
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide me with caution against offenses and wariness against slips in this world and the next in the state of satisfaction and wrath,

arabic_text: حَتَّى أكُونَ بِمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَنْزِلَة سَوَاء، عَامِلاً بِطَاعَتِكَ مُؤْثِراً لِرِضَاكَ عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُمَا فِي الأَوْلِياءِ وَالأعْدَاءِ
transliteration: ḥattá ʾakūna bimā yaridu ʿalayya minhumā bimanzilati sawāʾa ʿamilān bi-ṭāʿatika muʾthirān li-riḍāka ʿalā mā siwāhumā fī al-awliy
english_text: such that I may remain indifferent toward that which enters upon me from the two states, work toward Thy obedience, and prefer it and Thy good pleasure over all else in both friends and enemies.

arabic_text: حَتّى يَأْمَنَ عَدُوِّي مِنْ ظُلْمِي وَجَوْرِي، وَيَيْأَسَ وَلِيِّي مِنْ مَيْلِي وَانْحِطَاطِ هَوَايَ،
transliteration: ḥattā yaʾmana ʿaduwwī min ẓulmī wa jawrī wa yaya'sa waliyyi min mayli wa anhiṭaṭi hawayā
english_text: Then my enemy may stay secure from my wrongdoing and injustice and my friend may despair of my inclination and the bent of my affection.

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلنِي مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوكَ مُخْلِصاً في الرَّخَاءِ دُعَـاءَ الْمُخْلِصِينَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ لَـكَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
transliteration: wa-jaʿalnī mimmann yadʿūkā mukhliṣan fī r-raḵāʾ duʿāʾ al-mukhliṣīn al-muḍṭarṛīn laka fī al-duʿāʾ
english_text: Make me one of those who supplicate Thee with sincerity in ease with the supplication of those who supplicate Thee with sincerity in distress!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجيدٌ .
transliteration: ʾinnaka ḥamīdun majīdun
english_text: Verily Thou art Praiseworthy, Glorious.
